rows.grounds: etad (this, n.nom.sg) + ca (and, indecl.); sandhi etac ca
devadevena = by the God of gods (m.inst.sg)
darśitam = was shown (causative past passive participle, n.nom.sg of √dṛś)
bodhavṛddhaye = for growth of understanding (f.dat.sg, compound bodha+vṛddhi)
tato'pyanyatra = even elsewhere than that (tatas + api + anyatra; sandhi split)
nāpyalam = and not even fully (na + api + alam; sandhi)
